'''Edward Paddley''' is a [[human]] located at [[Crystal Falls]] in [[Northwind]]. He was placed in charge of the [[Defias Brotherhood]]'s incursion into Northwind by [[Edwin VanCleef]], taking advantage of the chaos caused by the Blackrock and Dark Iron invasions of the region in order to plunder it.<ref>[[VanCleef's Orders]]</ref>

==Abilities==
* Cleave
* Hamstring

==Objective of==
* Drops [[VanCleef's Orders]] for {{questlong|Alliance|32|Defying Odds}}
